summary: Toro Corp., a Cyprus-domiciled Nasdaq-listed shipping issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching an earnings press release dated October 9, 2026, disclosing second-quarter and first-half 2026 results: Q2 vessel revenues of $7.0 million (up 71.3%), net income of $0.6 million (down 60.9%), and H1 net income of $1.1 million (down 64.0%), with $80.2 million cash at June 30, 2026. The release recaps a previously completed $0.90/share special dividend paid June 5, 2026 ($3.8 million cash plus 5,707,246 shares), a previously completed spin-off of the LPG carrier business into AI OKTO CORP. (Nasdaq: AIOK), and post-quarter acquisition of two MR tankers. No new special-situations terms are stated; routine results disclosure only.
